match: compare current cash flow prior period
prompt: Compare my current cash flow with the prior comparable period.

results.text: Your net cash flow today is -$110, compared with +$190 on the prior comparable day. The swing is mostly the extra dining spending this period.

sql.command:
SELECT activity_date, inflows, outflows, net_flow
FROM aa_customer_money_summary
ORDER BY activity_date DESC LIMIT 2
